steps.text: Affix a new gasket to the cover.

provenance.quote: Affix a new gasket to the cover.

steps.text: Install the cover on the engine and secure it with bolts and lock washers. Tighten the bolts to 35 lb-ft (47 N-m) torque. Apply cup grease to the outside diameter of the oil seal spacers, then slide them on the shafts. Current engines use an oil slinger between the oil seal spacer and the shoulder on the camshaft and between the spacer and the end bearing on the balance shaft (In-line engine). Addition of the oil slinger improves sealing by reducing the amount of oil in the area of the oil seals. If oil slingers are installed on in-line engines built prior to serial numbers 20-9278, 3D-573 and 40-944, check the distance from the holes to the gasket flange (Fig. 2). If necessary, machine or grind the cover to provide sufficient clearance for the slingers. Install a Woodruff key in each shaft. Install the pulleys on the shafts. Install and tighten the pulley retaining nuts to 300-325 Ib-ft (407-441 №: т) torque.
